name: DyVal (Dynamic Evaluation Framework)
description: DyVal is a dynamic evaluation framework developed by Microsoft that creates adaptive assessments to address data pollution and control complexity in LLM benchmarking. Rather than using fixed static datasets, DyVal generates evaluation instances dynamically, controlling difficulty parameters to create more reliable and less contamination-prone measurements of LLM reasoning capabilities.
reputation: Microsoft-developed framework; cited as a response to data contamination and benchmark saturation concerns in the LLM evaluation community.
notes: Targets data contamination and benchmark saturation through dynamic instance generation. Controls complexity parameters explicitly. Positioned as a more sustainable alternative to static benchmarks.
